title: Verify Parts Manager sees only Parts, Finance, and Data Import in Settings
preconds: Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Parts Manager role. (per this role's Settings sub-toggles).
steps:
1. Click the Settings (cog) icon.
2. Note which sub-sections are listed.
3. Open Parts, Finance, and Data Import.
4. Look for App Settings and Wages.
expected:
Step 1: Settings opens.
Step 2: Parts, Finance, and Data Import are available.
Step 3: Each of the three opens successfully.
Step 4: App Settings and Wages are NOT available.
